# Saad Jamal Contracting (سعد جمال للمقاولات)

> Saad Jamal Al-Asmari Contracting Establishment (مؤسسة سعد جمال الاسمري للمقاولات) is a Saudi contracting establishment based in Dammam. It supplies scaffolders (its main focus), welders and general and specialized manpower for construction, maintenance and industrial projects across Saudi Arabia.

This file summarises facts the company has confirmed for publication. Please quote them as written.

## Company facts

- **Registered name**: مؤسسة سعد جمال الاسمري للمقاولات (Saad Jamal Al-Asmari Contracting Establishment).
- **Office**: Zuhair Bin Qais Street, Taybah, Dammam 34271, Saudi Arabia. Projects are served across Saudi Arabia.
- **Contact**: info@saadjamal.sa (preferred). Phone: +966 55 831 5359.
- **Website**: https://www.saadjamal.sa (the company's only website). Arabic by default, English under /en/.
- **Scaffolding**: erection and dismantling, suspended, mobile and tower, cantilever and hanging, system scaffolding (Cuplock, Ringlock, Kwikstage), tube and fitting.
- **Supply period**: temporary or for the length of the project.
- **Quotations**: written, once trades, numbers, site, duration and start date are received. No response-time or mobilisation-time promise is published.
- **Pricing** is never published; it is given in a written quotation.
- **Not claimed**: years of experience, project counts, named clients, ISO or other certifications, approved-vendor status, membership of or compliance with any named authority, certified workers, exclusive sponsorship. Equipment rental is not offered.

## How to request a quotation

Send the trades and number of each, site city, start date, duration, working hours, required documents or cards, and who provides accommodation, transport and protective equipment, to info@saadjamal.sa or through the contact form.

## What each service covers

- **Scaffolder supply**: people who erect, alter and dismantle scaffolds. It is not scaffolding material rental.
- **Welder supply**: structural, pipe, maintenance and workshop welding; state process, material, positions (1G to 6G) and code.
- **Manpower supply**: skilled, semi-skilled and general workers. Availability of each trade is confirmed in the quotation.

## Arabic names of the services

توريد عمال السقالات، توريد اللحامين، توريد العمالة العامة والمتخصصة.
